## Purpose
The rules API: rule types, CRUD and restore, categories, per-agent and per-workflow rules, agent rule activity, rule events, and suggestions.

## Responsibilities
`rulesApi`:
- types and list (`GET /api/rules`, with a scope parameter);
- create, update (PATCH), remove, restore;
- categories CRUD;
- agentRules and setAgentRules (PUT `/rules/agents/{id}`) and agentActivity;
- workflowRules;
- events (`GET /rules/events`);
- suggest (`POST /rules/suggest`).

## Key elements
`rulesApi`.
